A journey through the history of Tibia's development. Use the Thais time machine to enter the {wiki:Time Travel Dungeon|Time Travel Dungeon}, cross replicas of old zones in reverse order of release (from Forest of Life to Thais), complete an album of 8 photographs and defeat {creature:Lord Retro} in a 4-phase fight. You receive the achievement **First Achievement** and the base {wiki:Formal Dress Outfits|Formal Dress Outfits}.
Explore the history of Tibia's development and fight your way back to the past!

Time Travel Dungeon (free entry and exit)
In section 4, when you repair the time machine with the {item:Bronze Gear Wheel}, the {item:Copper Valve (Item)|Copper Valve}, the {item:Calibrated Indicator Gauge} and the {item:Glass Tube}.
From then on you enter and leave through the time machine in the basement of the **northeast** wall tower of Thais.
The purple teleport in the {wiki:Memory of a Werelion|Memory of a Werelion} room now takes you near the boss teleport.
The dungeon's creatures are *Memories* of the real creatures and are all of similar strength. Most are weaker than the original, except memories of weak creatures such as Amazons and Dwarf Guards.
You need **8 {item:Blank Paper|Blank Papers}** in total. All the places that give Blank Paper share a **2-minute** cooldown per character: there is no point running between two places.
Keep the {item:Palette and Brushes} and the photo album: you will need them until the end.
Bring spare soul points: each teleport to the next area costs 5.
In {wiki:Thais|Thais}, go to the **northeast** wall tower and go down the stairs. You will find a teleport machine: use it to enter the {wiki:Time Travel Dungeon|Time Travel Dungeon}.
You will pass through replicas of Tibia zones in reverse release order: you start at the Forest of Life (Summer Update 2021) and finish at Thais, the first city.

After you enter, the time machine on the inside is **broken**: you can only use it to leave the dungeon after repairing it with four parts (section 4). Bring everything you need (blessings, potions, soul points) before going in.
Follow the path to a lion statue. With the {item:White Silk Flower} on you, you can use the statue and move on.
Pick up the Palette and Brushes and the album

After getting past the wall, head **north** and take the {item:Palette and Brushes} from the sarcophagus. Next to it there is a *Brass-Shod Chest* with a {item:Half Empty Picture Album (Falcon Order)}.
Sarcophagus with the Palette and Brushes
In the room to the **east**, take a {item:Blank Paper} from a coffin.
Follow the dungeon to the portal at the end and enter.

Walk **north** from the entrance to a *Falcon Banner* on the wall. Near it, use the {item:Palette and Brushes} on a {item:Blank Paper}: you paint a {item:Picture of a Falcon Banner}. Use the picture on the album: it becomes a {item:Half Empty Picture Album (Halls of Hope)} (the sprite does not change).
Follow the dungeon to the other side. Near the portal, dig into the sand (the *Golden Quartzes*) until you find a {item:Tibia Coin (Item)|Tibia Coin}. With it you can pass through the portal.
The first time you pass through the portal the coin is used up. You can dig up a new one every 10 minutes.
Dig up the Golden Quartzes to find a Tibia Coin
Here you need to gather four parts to repair the time machine.
If you didn't bring one, loot a {item:Bronze Gear Wheel} from the golems.

Use the valve on the floor to take a {item:Copper Valve (Item)|Copper Valve}. Only the **lighter** valves ({item:Copper Valve|Copper Valves}) can be picked up. Once one is taken, a new one takes 5 minutes to appear.
Make sure you try to take the lighter valve (Copper Valve)
On a small pile of rubbish on the floor, pick up the {item:Calibrated Indicator Gauge}.
**North** of the golems there is a chest: take the {item:Glass Tube} from it.

Go back to the entrance as if you were returning to Thais. The time machine is broken: use the four items on it ({item:Bronze Gear Wheel}, {item:Copper Valve (Item)|Copper Valve}, {item:Calibrated Indicator Gauge} and {item:Glass Tube}). From now on you can leave the dungeon and come back whenever you like. To leave, use the repaired machine at the dungeon entrance: you return to the basement of the **northeast** wall tower of Thais. To get back in, use the machine in that basement again.
Blank Papers from Roshamuul and Fiehonja

Go back to the Oramond zone. In the Roshamuul zone pick up another {item:Blank Paper}. Continue to the Fiehonja zone, where there is one more {item:Blank Paper} to the **south**. Enter the portal to the next area.
In the building where you arrive, open a chest and take the {item:Wind-Up Loco} (needed for the {wiki:Gloothomotive|Gloothomotive} mount).
In the next room to the **south**, with Yalahari, click the skull on the floor to take a {item:Black Skull (Quest)}.
Find a nest with eggs to the **northwest** of the Svargrond zone and take a {item:Flask with Paint} from it. Use it on the baby seals nearby to paint **3** of them.
Jump into the water and open the floating bottle to take another {item:Blank Paper}.
Go through to the next area
Enter the teleport to the next area. Each time you do so you use up 5 soul points (*"Venturing forth into Tibia's past only costs you a small part of your soul. Go for it!"*).
Before you start this part, make sure you have the 5 regular blessings (or 5 Blessing Charms) and that you are promoted. Cross the jungle and enter the portal **south** of the desert.
Collect the skulls in the Venore zone
In the Venore zone you collect the remaining skulls:
In the little house north of the passage
On a skeleton near the portal

There are also 2 {item:Blank Paper|Blank Papers} in this area (marked on the map). Once you have all the skulls, including the {item:Black Skull (Quest)|Black Skull} from the previous area, enter the portal.
Go to the little house to the **southeast** and pick up another {item:Blank Paper}.
Walk **northwest** of the Edron zone, towards the Ab'Dendriel zone, then **south** to the Kazordoon zone. Look for a {item:Barrel}, use it and you get a {item:Commemorative Platinum Coin}.
Continue to the last room. Use the {item:Commemorative Platinum Coin} on the coin slot **west** of the final door and enter the next portal.
On the last floor, walk **north** to the room that looks like {npc:Frodo}'s food shop and enter the {item:Magic Forcefield (Orange)|orange forcefield}. It takes you to Calcanea (Retro).
On a dead human (*Dead Human*) pick up an {item:Old Health Potion}.
Dead Human with the Old Health Potion
Stand on the marked spot and use the {item:Palette and Brushes} on a {item:Blank Paper} to paint the {item:Picture of Calcanea}. Use it on the album.
Where to paint the Picture of Calcanea

You now have full access to the dungeon. To reach the boss you have to complete the album with **8 pictures**. You already have the {item:Picture of a Falcon Banner} and the {item:Picture of Calcanea}. Go to each of these locations, use the {item:Palette and Brushes} on a {item:Blank Paper} and use the picture on the album:
You can get more Blank Papers to paint extra pictures for decoration.

These pictures are painted **outside** the dungeon: leave through the repaired time machine. The Halls of Hope Picture and the Adventurers' Guild Picture are around **Thais**. For the others, take {npc:Captain Bluebear}'s boat at the port of Thais ({key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:venore} or {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}): the Carlin Bank is in **Carlin**, the Venore statue in **Venore** (2 floors above ground), the elven house in **Ab'Dendriel**. The Colossus is on top of the **Kazordoon** mountain (highest floor), which has no boat: go on foot (from Thais through the {wiki:Mount Sternum} pass) or by {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya or Farmine. To return to Thais, the captains of Carlin ({npc:Captain Greyhound}), Venore ({npc:Captain Fearless}) and Ab'Dendriel ({npc:Captain Seagull}) will take you there if you say {key:thais}.

With the album complete, go back to the Thais floor of the Time Travel Dungeon, head **northeast** and step into the blue fire: you are teleported to the {npc:MUD}'s room. Say {key:MUD}, confirm the following questions ({key:yes}) and accept the challenge against {creature:Lord Retro}. You are taken to a lever room similar to the one in {wiki:The Annihilator Quest|The Annihilator Quest}, but bigger.

The fight has 4 phases. Throughout the fight an 'X' with a number appears next to your character, which goes up when you are hit by the *exori* effect of {creature:Minor Bug|Minor Bugs} and {creature:Major Bug|Major Bugs}. To lower it, stand next to the {creature:Community Manager (Creature)|Community Manager} (present in 3 of the 4 phases) and let the {wiki:Hearts Effect|hearts effect} hit you. If the counter reaches **100**, you are kicked out. You also fail if the Community Manager dies: keep his creatures away and heal him with {spell:Mass Healing}.

{creature:Lord Retro} is unreachable to the **west**, protected by {creature:Parcel Castle|Parcel Castles}. You have to turn the {creature:Hard Times} (they look like {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}) into {creature:Blissful Times} (they look like Massive Energy Elementals), which explode and damage the parcels. Lure the Hard Times **east**, near the {creature:Time Distortion}: its attack forces the transformation. The Blissful Times only last a few seconds and disappear after an area attack, which also transforms nearby Hard Times. Form a **line of Hard Times** from the Time Distortion to the parcels so the chain reaction reaches them. Each attack that hits the parcels takes off 500 hp. Repeat until you destroy one of the four piles of parcels and **wait** in the room until you are teleported.
There is a teleport north of the room that takes you out of the fight. Don't step into it if you don't want to leave.

A {creature:Community Manager (Creature)|Community Manager} appears in the middle of the room. Protect him from the {creature:Major Bug|Major Bugs} and {creature:Minor Bug|Minor Bugs} by pulling them away. A {creature:Festival Cake (Creature)|Festival Cake} appears, which only dies from the area attacks of the Major and Minor Bugs. Dead cakes become {item:Festival Cake|cakes (items)}: use them on {creature:Lord Retro} to damage him. Repeat until Lord Retro disappears and you are teleported.
Protect the Community Manager and deal with each creature in a specific way:
Lure them onto the {item:Ignore Button|Ignore Buttons}.
Take an {item:Unremarkable Hammer} from the chest west of the room, use it on the Community Manager to turn him into {item:The Ban Hammer} and use it on the Toxic Tibia Troll.
As you ignore, pick up and ban the creatures, Lord Retro becomes frustrated until he disappears and you are teleported to the next phase.

Stay next to the Community Manager until your outfit turns into Ferumbras. You gain a special area attack that fires automatically. Use it to kill the {creature:Allusion|Allusions}: when they die they turn into an {item:Easter Egg}, which you should use on the {item:Magic Wall (Object)|Magic Wall}. Repeat **three times**; when the Magic Walls break, Lord Retro is free. Keep using the special attack to kill him.
Lord Retro's attack raises your counter very quickly. Whoever tanks should always stay next to the Community Manager.
When Lord Retro dies, the {creature:Retros Treasure} appears in the middle of the room. Destroy it with normal attacks.

After the fight, leave the room through the **north** teleport. To return to Thais, go back through the dungeon to the entrance and use the repaired time machine: you appear in the basement of the **northeast** wall tower of Thais.
After defeating the boss, the purple teleport in the {wiki:Memory of a Werelion|Memory of a Werelion} room works as a shortcut to near Lord Retro's teleport.
The {item:Wind-Up Loco} picked up in the Zao zone is needed for the {wiki:Gloothomotive|Gloothomotive} mount.
